hypotheses.A0_mlp_route_explains_most_native_effect: The complete attention-frozen MLP route predicts the dynamic-attention finite effect with fidelity at least 0.90 on every corpus.
hypotheses.A1_attention_correction_is_material: The dynamic-attention minus frozen-attention correction has norm at least 5% of the full finite effect on at least one corpus.
hypotheses.A2_four_mlp_paths_predict_native_effect: The frozen four-path MLP program alone predicts the dynamic-attention effect with fidelity at least 0.85 on every corpus.
hypotheses.A3_exact_attention_correction_closes_the: Adding the exact finite attention correction to the four-path MLP program reaches at least 0.94 fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.A4_attention_profile_transfers_ood: Attention-correction signed projection and norm ratio on each OOD corpus differ from FineWeb by at most 0.05.
hypotheses.A5_compact_mlp_error_dominates_attention: The four-path-plus-attention-correction residual is smaller than the omitted attention correction on every corpus.
